```{r setup}
library(ecTools)
library(tidyverse)
```

# Jensens inequality

Does  aggregation displacement depend on the variation in variable values?


```{r}
var1 <- rnorm(100, 10, 1)
var2 <- rnorm(100, 10, 2)
var3 <- rnorm(100, 10, 4)

jen <- tibble(var1, var2, var3, ind1, ind2, ind3)
```


```{r}
ec_ji <- function(var, xmin, xmax, ...) {

  # Check inputs
  stopifnot(
    is.numeric(var)
  )

  # Remove missing observations
  keep <- complete.cases(var)
  var <- var[keep]

  if (length(var) == 0) {
    stop("No complete observations.")
  }

  # Scaling function
  scale_fun <- function(x) {
    ecTools::ec_normalise(x, ...)
  }

  ind <- scale_fun(var)

  # Summary statistics
  meanvar <- mean(var)
  meanind <- mean(ind)
  indFromMeanVar <- scale_fun(meanvar)

  diff <- indFromMeanVar - meanind

  # Annotation positions
  xrange <- xmax - xmin

  x_arrow <- meanvar + 0.08 * xrange
  x_text <- x_arrow + 0.03 * xrange

  # Plot
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    data.frame(var, ind),
    ggplot2::aes(x = var, y = ind)
  ) +
    ggplot2::stat_function(
      fun = scale_fun,
      colour = "grey40",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
    ggplot2::geom_rug(
      sides = "b",
      alpha = 0.4
    ) +

    # Mean variable
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "segment",
      x = meanvar, xend = meanvar,
      y = 0, yend = indFromMeanVar,
      colour = "blue",
      linewidth = 1,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +

    # Indicator from mean variable
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "segment",
      x = xmin, xend = meanvar,
      y = indFromMeanVar, yend = indFromMeanVar,
      colour = "blue",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +

    # Mean indicator
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "segment",
      x = xmin, xend = meanvar,
      y = meanind, yend = meanind,
      colour = "red",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +

    # Difference arrow
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "segment",
      x = x_arrow, xend = x_arrow,
      y = meanind, yend = indFromMeanVar,
      arrow = grid::arrow(
        ends = "both",
        length = grid::unit(0.15, "cm")
      ),
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +

    # Difference label
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text",
      x = x_text,
      y = (meanind + indFromMeanVar) / 2,
      label = paste0("Difference = ", round(diff, 3)),
      hjust = 0,
      size = 5
    ) +

    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(0, 1),
      xlim = c(xmin, xmax),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = "Condition variable",
      y = "Condition indicator"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 16)
}
```

```{r}


# Linear scaling
ec_ji(
  var = jen$var1,
  x0 = 5,
  x100 = 11,
  fun = "linear"
) +
 xlim(c(0, 20))
ec_ji(
  var = jen$var2,
  x0 = 5,
  x100 = 11,
  fun = "linear"
)+
 xlim(c(0, 20))
ec_ji(
  var = jen$var3,
  x0 = 5,
  x100 = 11,
  fun = "linear"
)+
 xlim(c(0, 20))



# Concave scaling
exp <- .2
x0 <- 5
x100 <- 20

p1 <- ec_ji(
  var = jen$var1,
  xmin = 0,
  xmax = 20,
  x0 = x0,
  x100 = x100,
  fun = "exponential convex",
  convex_exponent = exp
)
p2 <- ec_ji(
  var = jen$var2,
  xmin = 0,
  xmax = 20,
  x0 = x0,
  x100 = x100,
  fun = "exponential convex",
  convex_exponent = exp
)
p3 <- ec_ji(
  var = jen$var3,
  xmin = 0,
  xmax = 20,
  x0 = x0,
  x100 = x100,
  fun = "exponential convex",
  convex_exponent = exp
)

library(patchwork)
out <- p1+p2+p3
ggsave(plot = out, filename = here::here("R/figures/jensen_inequality_example.png"), width = 40, height = 16, units ="cm")

```
